title: Velvety Keto Chinese Butter Beans Jiaozi
description: A rich and earthy Chinese dish featuring butter beans and a keto-friendly pasta water emulsion, served in a traditional terracotta dish. This crowd-pleaser is perfect for a special occasion or a cozy night in.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, cook the pork sausage over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the grated ginger and sesame oil to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Stir in the soy sauce and cook for an additional minute.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked sausage mixture, butter beans, and shirataki noodles.
In a small bowl, whisk together the pasta water and a pinch of salt to create a keto-friendly emulsion.
Add the emulsion to the bowl with the sausage mixture and stir until everything is well combined.
Spoon the mixture into a terracotta dish and top with chopped green onions.
Bake the jiaozi in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until the filling is hot and the noodles are tender.
Serve the Velvety Keto Chinese Butter Beans Jiaozi hot, garnished with additional green onions if desired.
